title: Implement dashboard command executor adapter
description: Implement the Plexus-owned executor that maps the portable durable command envelope and execution context to dashboard command execution and progress updates. Preserve provider-neutral command-worker contracts; do not retain legacy dispatcher fallback behavior. Include focused unit tests and document local validation.

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text: Completed the first executor-enabling slice: CommandProgress now stores progress state and callbacks in ContextVar bindings rather than process-wide class attributes. This prevents concurrent commands from cross-publishing lifecycle progress while preserving existing call sites. Added thread-isolation and nested-scope tests. Validation: python -m pytest plexus/cli/shared/command_progress_test.py plexus/cli/shared/command_tasks_test.py tests/command_worker -q (111 passed); ruff check plexus/cli/shared/CommandProgress.py plexus/cli/shared/command_progress_test.py; black and git diff checks; rcql -q --lang=python --scan-files ./plexus/cli/shared/CommandProgress.py --no-fail (0 findings).

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text: Implemented the typed CLI execution core. PlexusCliExecutor consumes a strict argv-array payload, optionally exposes an established task-id environment binding, routes CommandProgress updates to the portable ExecutionContext, restores argv/environment after success or failure, and bounds captured output. Added scoped CommandProgress callback binding to prevent state bleed between executions. Validation: python -m pytest plexus/cli/shared/command_progress_test.py tests/command_worker/test_plexus_cli_executor.py tests/command_worker -q (112 passed); ruff and black checks; git diff --check; rcql -q --lang=python --scan-files ./plexus/command_worker/executors/* --no-fail (0 findings).

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text: Added the runtime plugin factory plexus.command_worker.executors.plexus_cli:create_executor, so the portable runtime can instantiate the typed CLI executor using its existing explicit plugin contract. Additional validation: python -m pytest tests/command_worker/test_plexus_cli_executor.py tests/command_worker/test_runtime_entrypoint.py -q (22 passed).

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text: Design decision after implementing the typed executor: do not let the executor mark dashboard tasks terminal. Durable lifecycle completion occurs after Executor.execute returns; a lease-loss race could otherwise display completed in the dashboard when the command was not durably completed. The executor owns CLI invocation plus durable progress publication. A separate lifecycle-state projection must drive dashboard terminal status after the durable transition succeeds.

comments.author: unknown
comments.text: Closed in board cleanup 2026-10-17: the command service is implemented and merged (primus/command_worker with Celery delivery, DynamoDB lease and fencing lifecycle, ECS task protection, CLI executor; dashboard submitCommand resolver and dashboard/amplify/command-service), with tests in tests/command_worker and submitCommand.test.ts. The production foundation was deployed per infrastructure/docs/command-service-foundation.md. Reopen if a specific gap surfaces.
